excluded.scope: obstacle, reference, unknown, and other non-floor/wall/ceiling truth labels are excluded; non-three-class predictions for eligible truths are excluded from the 3x3 confusion matrix

uncertainty_coverage.conditioning: conditional fields require a gated match and evaluable posterior; end_to_end fields count misses and missing intervals as false
uncertainty_coverage.position_interval_interpretation: Gaussian-equivalent 90% covariance ellipsoid scaled by the three-dimensional chi-square 0.9 quantile; it is not an empirical highest-posterior-density credible region

count_bias.calibration_warning: These residuals reuse fitted observations and do not establish calibration bias; use an independent calibration or held-out set.

operational_timing_definitions.end_to_end_wall_clock_s: Wall time from online-loop initialization through final evaluation and strict payload sanitization; final JSON I/O and notification are excluded.
operational_timing_definitions.final_mle_time_s: Compatibility aggregate of final point reporting and successful surface solver time.
operational_timing_definitions.final_point_reporting_pipeline_time_s: Final point-estimate selection, pruning, refit, and absent-isotope reporting time; visualization and file output are excluded.
operational_timing_definitions.final_surface_map_mle_time_s: Compatibility completed-fit time; equal to surface_map_solver_time_s only when the solver completes without an error.
operational_timing_definitions.online_wall_clock_s: Wall time from online-loop initialization through simulator close; final reporting, plotting, surface reconstruction, and evaluation are excluded.
operational_timing_definitions.surface_map_attempt_time_s: Total surface-map wrapper time including preflight and failed or memory-guarded attempts.
operational_timing_definitions.surface_map_solver_time_s: Time spent inside the final surface-map solver when attempted.

station_height_count_definitions.height_pair_station_count: Number of unique XY stations observed at more than one detector height.
station_height_count_definitions.height_transition_count: Number of consecutive measurement rows whose detector heights differ by more than the planner Z tolerance.
station_height_count_definitions.position_source: MeasurementRecord.detector_position_xyz_m, falling back to the registered pose only when the record has no explicit detector position.
station_height_count_definitions.station_visit_count: Number of contiguous measurement-sequence visits to an XY station; same-XY height actions remain one visit, and a later revisit is counted.
station_height_count_definitions.unique_xy_station_count: Number of tolerance-connected unique detector XY stations.
station_height_count_definitions.unique_xyz_action_count: Number of tolerance-connected unique detector XYZ actions.
